task.title: Preparing for Meeting with Potential Buyer

user_message.content: my parents and sister have a meeting this upcoming saturday with a potential buyer that is very interested in purchasing our family's oil service company.  I would like to prepare something for them to take into the meeting to show that they are prepared and serious about her inquiry.  Can you help me draft something up for them to take to the dinner? Ask me any questions you need to help with you construction of this

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content: I can help prepare a polished, meeting-ready buyer packet. To tailor it appropriately, please share: **(1)** the company name, location/service area, and core oilfield services; **(2)** a short company history, key equipment/assets, customers or contract profile, employee count, and differentiators; **(3)** what financial information you are comfortable presenting (for example, revenue range, EBITDA/cash flow, backlog, or whether to keep figures confidential until an NDA); and **(4)** the family’s goals for the dinner—initial credibility packet only, or also a proposed sale process, valuation expectations, and next steps. If you prefer, I can begin with a discreet, professional one-page company overview plus a meeting agenda using placeholders.

user_message.content: I can give P&Ls, Cash Flow, Employee list, equipment/assets, vendors, customers, location, name etc

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content:
Excellent—those materials are enough to tailor the packet into a credible, company-specific buyer presentation. Please upload them when ready, preferably as PDFs, Excel files, or exports. For privacy, do **not** include employee Social Security numbers, home addresses, bank details, or other unnecessary personal information; employee names, roles, tenure, pay bands, and aggregate headcount are usually sufficient for this stage.

Please also tell me whether the potential buyer is an **individual, strategic company, or investment group**, and whether your family wants the buyer-facing packet to include financial ranges now or reserve financial detail until a mutual confidentiality agreement is signed. Once I have the materials, I will distill them into a customized leave-behind and an internal discussion guide without sharing sensitive customer, vendor, or employee details unnecessarily.

user_message.content: The potential buyers name is Cortney Legard.... she owns companies called Cortney Legard. Can you see if you can find any professional information about her ?

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content: I’ll look for publicly available professional information about Cortney Legard and any businesses associated with her, focusing on business roles, company activity, and credible public sources rather than private personal details.

I have completed a public-source review of Cortney LeGard and attached a concise professional background brief for your family to read before Saturday’s dinner. 

The public record supports her association with two private, field-service-oriented businesses: **Rail 1 LLC** (a railroad maintenance contractor) and **Petro-Flow Control LLC** (an oilfield well-servicing and equipment supplier). This suggests she has relevant operating experience. The brief also notes a 2025 federal patent docket involving Petro-Flow Control and Cortney LeGard that ended in a settlement and a stipulated injunction. 

Because public records cannot confirm her current financial capacity, acquisition track record, or the terms of that court order, the brief includes a set of neutral, professional questions your family can ask at dinner to gauge her seriousness and readiness to proceed. Please review the attached document, and let me know if you would like me to incorporate this context into the customized buyer packet once you provide your company’s materials.
